A crewman is caught in quicksand; the menu offers pulling him out herself or calling everyone to help. In the first variant Maria asks him to hold on and other voices call for help for the admiral; FI becomes a little fatigued. In the other she directs the crew to pull him out, with sailor fatigue. Further alternative voices wonder when they will leave the desert and point to a sight. Preserve the male crewman's rescue, differing fatigue notices and uncertain near-exit estimates; no deaths, item uses or guaranteed route length are supplied.

records.source_meaning: Shipyard worker asks for expertise in shipbuilding and gunnery.
records.whole_exchange_context: A shipyard worker asks for shipbuilding and gunnery expertise. Janas, Manuel, Cesare and Charles have source-dependent reply alternatives; Charles is the gunnery expert while the others discuss ships. The worker describes a new European carronade in the game's own terms as long-range and powerful, threatening Islamic fleets' boarding tactics, and is developing armor in response. Preserve those source claims even if historical real-world specifications differ. Missing-specialist branches request a later return. The source R223 uses actor18, despite feminine phrasing; retain its native identity as a binding question rather than silently changing the speaker. In success variants Charles explains powder force, Janas suggests hull angles, Cesare material strength and Manuel armor placement. The shipyard worker completes the design and asks them to notify the guildmaster. No extra engineer rank, guaranteed combat statistics or live naval upgrade effect is invented.
